verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer that stores user data, so data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The pack never documents retention policies, TTLs, or deletion endpoints or commands. The only related item is self-hosting to keep data on your own infrastructure, which controls where data lives, not how long it is kept or how it is deleted, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
